inputs.label: FY2024 Form 10-K, cover page
inputs.quote: As of January 31, 2025, 432,876,657 shares of the registrant's Class A common stock were outstanding, 188,462,942 shares of the registrant's Class B common stock were outstanding, no shares of the registrant's Class C common stock were outstanding, and 9,200,000 shares of the registrant's Class H common stock were outstanding.

source.label: FY2024 Form 10-K, Item 5
source.quote: Class A common stock: 905 stockholders of record. This number does not include stockholders for whom shares were held in "nominee" or "street name." • Class B common stock: 74 stockholders of record.

notes: NBIM: the quote is this company's row in NBIM's year-end 2024 holdings data file ("o" = ownership %, "eq.v" = voting %, "a.e" = market value in USD, "a.n" = in NOK); the same line in NBIM's equity CSV download (https://www.nbim.no/api/investments/v2/report/?assetType=eq&date=2024-12-31&fileType=csv) reads "North America;United States;Airbnb Inc;Consumer Discretionary;4785543315;421360909;0.07%;0.5%". CalPERS: the source is CalPERS's 13F-HR/A (restatement) for the quarter ended December 31, 2024, filed April 23, 2025; its information table is identical to the original 13F-HR filed February 12, 2025. Form 13F covers only U.S.-listed securities, and the quoted row gives issuer, class, CUSIP, value in dollars and shares. CalPERS: Denominator is Class A plus Class B; the 9,200,000 Class H shares are excluded because the 10-K says all of them are held by Airbnb's wholly-owned Host Endowment Fund subsidiary. Holders of record: Listed Class A only; the 10-K also gives 74 holders of record of Class B.
